s.n: Cirque Arcanus mushroom and gruyère galettes
s.note: Buckwheat crêpes folded round mushrooms, gruyère and a soft egg, Paris street style
s.how: Whisk the buckwheat flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt into a thin batter and rest 20 minutes. Fry the mushrooms in half the butter with thyme until golden. Season. Butter a hot frying pan and swirl in a ladle of batter. Cook 2 minutes until set. Scatter with gruyère and mushrooms, crack an egg in the middle and fold the edges in to make a square. Cover and cook 3 minutes until the white sets. Repeat with the rest and serve hot.

m.note: Chicken pieces braised in red wine with bacon, small onions and mushrooms
m.how: Brown 1.2kg chicken pieces and 150g bacon lardons. Add 12 small onions and 250g mushrooms, then 500ml red wine, 250ml stock and thyme. Simmer covered 45 minutes and serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: Filo rolled around cinnamon green apple and sultanas
w.how: Toss 4 sliced green apples with 80g sultanas, a teaspoon of cinnamon and a handful of breadcrumbs. Layer buttered filo sheets, spread the filling along one edge and roll up. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 35 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

w.note: Puff pastry rolled around dark chocolate and baked into crescents
w.how: Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into long triangles. Lay a stick of dark chocolate at the wide end and roll up towards the point. Curve into crescents, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

w.note: Fried yeast doughnuts filled with plum jam
w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 2 eggs, 50g butter and warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Roll into balls, prove again and fry at 175C until golden. Pipe plum jam into each and dust with icing sugar. A proper bakery treat.

d.n: Paris café au lait with vanilla Chantilly
d.note: Strong coffee with hot milk, topped with vanilla whipped cream
d.how: Whip 150ml cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and half a teaspoon vanilla to soft peaks. Brew 500ml strong coffee in a plunger or stovetop pot. Heat 500ml full cream milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk. Pour the coffee and milk into 4 big cups at the same time, half and half. Top with a spoon of the vanilla cream and a pinch of cocoa.
